posts.text: Medicaid fraud is real — $1.1 trillion in improper payments over 10 years. Ohio Medicaid expenses went from $27 billion to $47 billion in a decade while enrollees only grew by 100,000. We prosecute the bad guys and put those billions back in the pockets of hardworking people following the rules.
